figurative_meaning_en: A person with the ability to speak endlessly or volubly
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা কথার জাহাজ, কখনো চুপ করে না।
মিটিংয়ে কথার জাহাজটি সবাইকে মুগ্ধ করে দিল তার বক্তৃতায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real ship of words; he never stops talking.
The chatterbox in the meeting captivated everyone with his endless speech.
note: This idiom metaphorically compares abundant speech to a ship that carries vast loads, reflecting Bengali cultural appreciation for verbal expressiveness.
